body: Heartbeat is one-way ping from each side on its own write-idle timer (interval 30 s), no pong; each side drops the link after 90 s without any frame. Chosen over ping/pong because every side already refreshes the peer's read timer by its own pings; a pong adds a message type and changes nothing about detection.

TCP keepalive via socket2 0.6 as a direct dependency (already in Cargo.lock through tokio, no new download) set in tls.rs HubAddr::connect and Incoming::accept (idle 30 s, interval 10 s). Alternative tokio/std: neither exposes the keepalive idle time.

Short intervals for tests come through LinkConfig.heartbeat (agent) and a new ingress::serve_agents_with (hub); serve_agents keeps its signature and uses Heartbeat::default(), so no existing call site changed. Alternative paused tokio time was rejected: real sockets and connect timeouts in the same tests.
